description: This PHP script manages custom field editing within the TestLink project, including creating, editing, updating, deleting, and rendering custom field forms, as well as handling configuration and access rights.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for handling custom fields, including CRUD operations and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering HTML templates.

methods.name: getCFCfg
methods.description: Generates configuration object for custom fields, including application areas and allowed nodes.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object for custom field views.

methods.name: request2cf
methods.description: Parses form request data to extract custom field parameters, setting enable/show flags based on 'enable_on' value.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for action handling.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Retrieves existing custom field data for editing, including linked test projects.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Creates a new custom field after validating name uniqueness.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field, ensuring name is unique.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a custom field and logs the event.

methods.name: cfieldCfgInit
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for custom fields, including application areas and allowed nodes.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Sets environment and renders the appropriate Smarty template for custom field forms.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to manage custom fields.
